question.worked_solution:
We start by creating a matrix whose columns are made up of our vectors, and then we reduce the matrix to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 & -3 \\ 0 & -1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, our matrix is already in a row echelon form.

The pivot columns correspond to basis vectors, while the non-pivot columns correspond to linearly dependent vectors that can be removed. Here, the reduced matrix has $4$ pivot columns (or alternatively, $4$ non-zero rows). 

Therefore, the dimension of the span is $4.$
